methodology: Independent recalculation from exhibits; answer-key blind until after own solution derived

items.concept: Residual Income = Operating Income - (Required Rate × Average Operating Assets)
items.tolerance_check: Dollar amount, exact match within $1 tolerance

items.prompt: Enter Motor Division ROI percentage as a whole number.
items.concept: ROI = Operating Income / Average Operating Assets

items.prompt: Enter equivalent units for conversion costs using weighted-average.
items.concept: Equivalent Units = Completed Units + (Ending WIP × Completion %)

items.prompt: Enter conversion cost per equivalent unit.
items.concept: Cost per EU = Total Conversion Cost / Equivalent Units

items.prompt: Enter the terminated-user exception rate as a percentage rounded to one decimal place.
items.tolerance_check: Percentage, rounded to 1 decimal; exact match

items.prompt: Enter the inventory write-down required under lower of cost and NRV.
items.concept: Lower of Cost or NRV: Write-down = Cost - NRV when NRV < Cost
items.tolerance_check: Dollar amount, exact match within $1 tolerance

items.prompt: Enter the amount added to the asset cost for the asset retirement obligation at initial recognition.
items.concept: ARO present value is capitalized as part of the related asset cost (ASC 410-20)
items.tolerance_check: Dollar amount, exact match within $1 tolerance

items.prompt: Enter operating cash flow using the listed cash-flow data before separately adjusting for the inventory write-down.
items.concept: Indirect method: NI + Depreciation - Increase in Inventory + Increase in Accrued Liabilities
items.tolerance_check: Dollar amount, exact match within $1 tolerance

items.concept: Sales Dollars = Expected Units × Selling Price
items.tolerance_check: Dollar amount, exact match within $1 tolerance

items.prompt: Enter expected current-month cash collections from current-month sales.
items.concept: Cash Collections = Expected Sales × Current-Month Collection %
items.tolerance_check: Dollar amount, exact match within $1 tolerance

items.prompt: Enter total cash available before disbursements.
items.concept: Cash Budget: Beginning Cash + Current Collections + Prior-Month Collections
items.tolerance_check: Dollar amount, exact match within $1 tolerance

items.prompt: Enter the unfavorable operating income variance as a positive amount.
items.tolerance_check: Dollar amount, exact match within $1 tolerance
